💡 inspektor-gadget | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: System inspection and data collection on Kubernetes and Linux hosts using eBPF.
✨ Key Features: • Build and package eBPF programs into OCI images (Gadgets) • Targets Kubernetes clusters and Linux hosts • Collect and export data to observability tools • Security mechanisms for Gadget execution control • Automatic enrichment of kernel data to high-level resources
📖 Summary: Inspektor Gadget is a framework and toolset for collecting data and inspecting systems on Kubernetes clusters and Linux hosts. It leverages eBPF technology to package, deploy, and run eBPF programs (called Gadgets) encapsulated in OCI images, offering mechanisms for customization and extension.
